content: In Revelation, Jesus says, “Behold, I stand at the door and…”
explanation: He wants to come in. “Behold, I stand at the door and knock.” (Revelation 3:20, BSB)
tags: Jesus Stands at the Door and Knocks

content: In Revelation, what will Jesus do if anyone opens the door?
options: Come in and dine with him
explanation: He desires friendship. “If anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in and dine with him, and he with Me.” (Revelation 3:20, BSB)
tags: Jesus Stands at the Door and Knocks

content: In Revelation, to which church did Jesus say, “I stand at the door and knock”?
explanation: It was the last of the seven churches. “To the angel of the church in Laodicea write” (Revelation 3:14, BSB)
tags: Jesus Stands at the Door and Knocks

content: In Revelation, Jesus told the church in Laodicea they were neither cold nor what?
explanation: They were lukewarm. “I know your deeds; you are neither cold nor hot.” (Revelation 3:15, BSB)
tags: Jesus Stands at the Door and Knocks

content: In Revelation, what did the church in Laodicea say about itself?
explanation: But they were really poor. “You say, ‘I am rich; I have grown wealthy and need nothing.’” (Revelation 3:17, BSB)
tags: Jesus Stands at the Door and Knocks

content: In His letter to Laodicea, whom does Jesus say He rebukes and disciplines?
explanation: So be earnest and repent. “Those I love, I rebuke and discipline.” (Revelation 3:19, BSB)
tags: Jesus Stands at the Door and Knocks

content: At the end of His letter to Laodicea, who should hear what the Spirit says?
explanation: The message is for everyone. “He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.” (Revelation 3:22, BSB)
tags: Jesus Stands at the Door and Knocks

content: In Revelation, what did John see after the first heaven and earth passed away?
explanation: God makes all things new. “Then I saw a new heaven and a new earth” (Revelation 21:1, BSB)
tags: A New Heaven and a New Earth

content: In Revelation, which holy city did John see coming down from heaven?
explanation: It was prepared like a bride. “I saw the holy city, the new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God” (Revelation 21:2, BSB)
tags: A New Heaven and a New Earth

content: In the new heaven and earth, what will God wipe from every eye?
explanation: No more death or pain. “He will wipe away every tear from their eyes” (Revelation 21:4, BSB)
tags: A New Heaven and a New Earth

content: In the new heaven and earth, what will be no more?
explanation: The former things have passed away. “and there will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain” (Revelation 21:4, BSB)
tags: A New Heaven and a New Earth

content: In Revelation, what did the One on the throne say He makes?
explanation: These words are faithful and true. “Behold, I make all things new.” (Revelation 21:5, BSB)
tags: A New Heaven and a New Earth

content: In the new Jerusalem, what was each gate made of?
explanation: There were twelve gates. “And the twelve gates were twelve pearls, with each gate consisting of a single pearl.” (Revelation 21:21, BSB)
tags: A New Heaven and a New Earth

content: Why does the new Jerusalem need no sun or moon?
explanation: The Lamb is its lamp. “because the glory of God illuminates the city, and the Lamb is its lamp.” (Revelation 21:23, BSB)
tags: A New Heaven and a New Earth

content: At the end of Revelation, Jesus says, “I am the Alpha and the…”
explanation: The First and the Last. “I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.” (Revelation 22:13, BSB)
tags: I Am the Alpha and the Omega

content: At the end of Revelation, Jesus calls Himself the Beginning and the what?
explanation: He is over all time. “the Beginning and the End.” (Revelation 22:13, BSB)
tags: I Am the Alpha and the Omega

content: In Revelation, what flows from the throne of God and of the Lamb?
options: A river of the water of life
explanation: It is clear as crystal. “Then the angel showed me a river of the water of life, as clear as crystal, flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb” (Revelation 22:1, BSB)
tags: I Am the Alpha and the Omega

content: In Revelation, which tree stands on either side of the river of life?
explanation: Its leaves heal the nations. “On either side of the river stood a tree of life” (Revelation 22:2, BSB)
tags: I Am the Alpha and the Omega

content: At the end of Revelation, what will there be no more of in the city?
explanation: The Lord God will shine on them. “There will be no more night in the city” (Revelation 22:5, BSB)
tags: I Am the Alpha and the Omega

content: At the end of Revelation, what does Jesus promise?
explanation: John answers, Come, Lord Jesus! “Yes, I am coming soon.” (Revelation 22:20, BSB)
tags: I Am the Alpha and the Omega

content: At the end of Revelation, Jesus calls Himself the bright what?
explanation: He is also David's Root. “I am the Root and the Offspring of David, the bright Morning Star.” (Revelation 22:16, BSB)
tags: I Am the Alpha and the Omega

content: On which island was John when he received the Revelation?
explanation: He was there for his testimony. “was on the island of Patmos because of the word of God and my testimony about Jesus.” (Revelation 1:9, BSB)

content: In Revelation, to how many churches was John told to send his scroll?
explanation: Ephesus through Laodicea. “Write on a scroll what you see and send it to the seven churches” (Revelation 1:11, BSB)

content: In Revelation, what had the church in Ephesus abandoned?
explanation: Jesus called them back. “You have abandoned your first love.” (Revelation 2:4, BSB)

content: In Revelation, what word describes the church in Laodicea?
explanation: Neither hot nor cold. “So because you are lukewarm—neither hot nor cold” (Revelation 3:16, BSB)

content: In Revelation, what do the four living creatures never stop saying?
explanation: Day and night they praise God. “Holy, Holy, Holy, is the Lord God Almighty, who was and is and is to come!” (Revelation 4:8, BSB)

content: In Revelation, who triumphed to open the scroll and its seven seals?
explanation: He is the Root of David. “Behold, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has triumphed to open the scroll” (Revelation 5:5, BSB)

content: In Revelation, what did the great multitude before the throne hold?
explanation: They wore white robes. “They were wearing white robes and holding palm branches in their hands.” (Revelation 7:9, BSB)

content: In the new Jerusalem, what was the main street made of?
explanation: It was clear as glass. “The main street of the city was pure gold, as clear as glass.” (Revelation 21:21, BSB)

content: Why was there no temple in the new Jerusalem?
options: God and the Lamb are its temple
explanation: God dwells with His people. “because the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are its temple.” (Revelation 21:22, BSB)

content: In Revelation, only those whose names are written where may enter the city?
explanation: Nothing unclean will enter. “but only those whose names are written in the Lamb’s Book of Life.” (Revelation 21:27, BSB)

content: In the new Jerusalem, whose names were written on the twelve gates?
explanation: An angel stood at each gate. “twelve gates inscribed with the names of the twelve tribes of Israel” (Revelation 21:12, BSB)

content: In the new Jerusalem, whose names were on the twelve foundations?
explanation: Apostles of the Lamb. “The wall of the city had twelve foundations bearing the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.” (Revelation 21:14, BSB)

content: In Revelation, how many kinds of fruit does the tree of life bear?
explanation: A fresh crop each month. “bearing twelve kinds of fruit and yielding a fresh crop for each month.” (Revelation 22:2, BSB)

content: In Revelation, what are the leaves of the tree of life for?
explanation: Healing for all peoples. “And the leaves of the tree are for the healing of the nations.” (Revelation 22:2, BSB)

content: In Revelation, on which day was John in the Spirit?
explanation: He heard a voice like a trumpet. “On the Lord’s day I was in the Spirit” (Revelation 1:10, BSB)

content: In Revelation, where will God's name be on His servants?
explanation: They will see His face. “They will see His face, and His name will be on their foreheads.” (Revelation 22:4, BSB)

content: In Revelation, at whose feet did John fall to worship before being stopped?
explanation: The angel told him to worship God. “I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who had shown me these things.” (Revelation 22:8, BSB)
